Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3587-6338-7711.manaNeeded: {2}{W} if you don't control your commander

Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Flawless Maneuver.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.

Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.

Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1558-6741-7638.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.

Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4885-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

If you have a repeated way to deal noncombat damage to any other opponent(s) who control a creature, you may repeat this loop for those opponents.

All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.

The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.

Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.

Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.

Repeat from step 4.

If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

Vilis triggers, causing that player to draw cards equal to the amount of life lost this way.

When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.

Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
